no_code_path: The rule constrains the RRSIGs of a signed zone, which only the zone signer produces. Ze creates no DNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC or DS record: geodns answerQuestions synthesizes A/AAAA/SRV/SOA/NS only and as112 answers negatively, and no layer signs on Ze's behalf.
note: Binds the signer of a signed zone; Ze signs no zone.
